title: Verb ないほうがいい (Verb nai hou ga ii)
shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that it is better not to do something.
longExplanation: The ないほうがいい grammar point is used to suggest that it's better not to do a certain action. It is formed by taking the negative form of the verb and adding ほうがいい.

examples.jp: この薬は飲まないほうがいいです。
examples.romaji: Kono kusuri wa nomanai hou ga ii desu.
examples.en: It's better not to take this medicine.

examples.jp: 急いでいるときは、走らないほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Isoide iru toki wa, hashiranai hou ga ii.
examples.en: When you're in a hurry, it's better not to run.

examples.jp: 彼に秘密を知られたくなければ、話さないほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Kare ni himitsu o shiraretakunakereba, hanasanai hou ga ii.
examples.en: If you don't want him to know your secret, it's better not to tell him.

examples.jp: 雨の日には、外出しないほうがいい。
examples.romaji: Ame no hi ni wa, gaishutsu shinai hou ga ii.
examples.en: It's better not to go out on a rainy day.
